fusions.name: Call In the Pack
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 27 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood Trail
fusions.desc: Sends a snapping set of jaws at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Whale Fall
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Heel-Swimmer
fusions.desc: A spurhound pup swims at your heel, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
